issue.title: `gj` and `gk` wrong behaviour (screen-wide line, listchars eol, virtualedit)

labels.name: closed:wontfix
labels.description: current behavior is by design, and change is not desired

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
### Problem

`gj` and `gk` behave like `j` and `k`.

related: #32405

### Steps to reproduce

minimal.lua:

```
vim.opt.list = true
vim.opt.listchars = {eol = "$"}
vim.opt.virtualedit = "all" -- or "onemore"

long_line = string.rep("-", vim.api.nvim_win_get_width(0))
vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(0, 0, 1, true, {long_line, "---"})
```

1. `nvim --clean -u minimal.lua`
2. press `gj` `gk`

### Expected behavior

`gj` `gk` should place cursor on the second screen line

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.12.0-dev-9+gc5044bd021

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

yes

### Operating system/version

6.13.7-arch1-1

### Terminal name/version

st 0.8.5

### $TERM environment variable

st-256color

### Installation

AUR
